messages:
julia: Quick FYI — I opened a PR to change the role lifecycle and UI gating for Console roles. Goal: make viewer/editor/admin canonical, split temporary project-level editor into `project-contributor`, and tighten downstream implicit perms. Patch: https://git.redwood/infra/console/merge/1245 :eyes:

matt: thanks. does the change affect api keys / service tokens visibility for viewers? last outage surface was from a viewer seeing a stale api key link.

julia: good call. policy: viewers will not see API keys or token management buttons. UI will hide elements and backend will check `can_manage_tokens` scope on requests. added unit + e2e checks.

kevin: found something in staging while smoke testing — users with `project-contributor` could still call the legacy /projects/:id/export endpoint and get CSV with owner emails. looks like we missed a backend gate. I can repro with `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer ..."`

security-bot: [alert] privilege-scan: staging export endpoint returned 1 sensitive field (owner_email) for role=project-contributor at 2024-07-12T14:03:21Z

julia: ack. thanks kevin. that endpoint should check `project.read_sensitive` scope. pushing hotfix now.

ops-bot: deploy pipeline started for infra/console branch role-matrix-hotfix (build 9842) — status: running

matt: separate question: what about KMS audit entries for role changes? we need to ensure role assignment and key-wrapping operations are logged to the customer KMS and central audit.

julia: plan: when console writes role bindings we will (1) emit internal audit event (structured) (2) attach a KMS-encrypted payload to the customer's audit log if the change touches a customer-managed key — and surface a KMS event id in the audit row. I'll add a migration note for existing bindings so the audit id is backfilled where possible.

alex: for rollout: can we do a canary for one org/customer and a short TTL on the new `project-contributor` token so we can revoke quickly if something breaks? also need a rollback doc.

kevin: agree on canary. also suggest a quick telemetry check list: attempt export endpoint, token-create, token-list, role-assignment, and UI visibility. I can add a k6 script.

julia: added checklist in PR description and a small test script: ```bash
# quick smoke for canary org
TOKEN=$(curl -s -X POST -d '{"user":"canary-bot"}' https://staging.console/api/token | jq -r .token)
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://staging.console/api/projects/123/export || echo "export blocked"
```

matt: thumbs up. please include audit log examples in the PR so compliance can sign off. they want the KMS event id and actor in the same row.

julia: will do. i'll also link the rollback steps and a short incident playbook in the PR. expecting to merge after tests pass and kevin's k6 run.

security-bot: [info] compliance-checklist: role-change PR 1245 assigned to @security for review.

kevin: running k6 now, sending results in ~20m.

julia: thanks all. if anyone sees unexpected exposure in the canary ping this thread and tag @oncall.
